en: A colorized panoramic view of a small European town with tightly packed multi‑story buildings and red roofs, surrounded by green hills and fields in the background. A prominent church with a tall tower and spire rises above the town center. In the foreground are tree‑lined streets and large industrial or institutional buildings with long red roofs. At the bottom of the image is a white border with printed red text indicating the town name and publisher information.
